title: Terrible Experience: One Adapter Burned Out, Second Never Delivered
text:
This purchase was a complete disaster from start to finish. I ordered two USB headset adapters, and only one was delivered. The second one was inexplicably returned before it even left the seller’s country. No explanation, no communication—just terrible service.

The one adapter I did receive worked for about a month before it completely failed. When it stopped working, there was a distinct electrical smell, which makes me suspect that a capacitor or another component burned out. For such a simple product, this level of failure is unacceptable and even raises safety concerns.

I am deeply disappointed with both the product quality and the service. If you’re considering this adapter, save yourself the frustration and avoid it entirely. Poor quality control, unreliable shipping, and a complete lack of durability—this product and seller have earned a hard pass from me.

title: Great product. No batteries needed. Made in USA
text:
I wanted to use my 30 year old GA headset with my PC. I have a Pilot Avionics PA11-40 headset. Ordered this adapter & it shipped the next day. Came with USB-C to USB adapter which is nice. Also came with optional adhesive pad to make mounting easy. You can also use screws. I mounted this under my desk, so it is out of the way. I plug in my headset into the ports and can use my headset for my audio in & out on my pc. I can game with my sons. They say my voice quality is clear playing Halo :) I can use it to do YouTube and flight simulator.

Great solution. No battery needed. Thank you for developing this. Exactly what I needed. Bonus that it is designed and made in the USA.
